listings.rawTitle: Rayhaan Nava Sol Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Nava Sol rises like the first warmth of morning — a radiant opening of dewy pear, juicy and softly sweet, entwined with the powdery, slightly floral shimmer of ambrette. It's a bright, luminous beginning that feels fresh, natural, and quietly sensual.. At its heart, the fragrance blooms into full elegance. Velvety magnolia and delicate jasmine intertwine in a graceful floral embrace, while creamy sandalwood lends smoothness and depth. The effect is romantic yet refined — a bouquet touched with golden light.. As it lingers, Nava Sol settles into a warm, enveloping glow. Rich cedarwood brings a noble, woody structure, musk adds a soft skin-like intimacy, and amber wraps everything in radiant warmth. The result is a lasting trail that feels sunlit, sophisticated, and deeply comforting.. Effortlessly warm and gracefully modern, Rayhaan Nava Sol is a fragrance for those drawn to light — a celebration of golden moments and quiet radiance.. Top Notes: Ambrette and Pear Heart Notes: Magnolia, Sandalwood and Jasmine Base Notes: Cedarwood, Musk and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Rayhaan Cedrus Blanc Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Rayhaan Cedrus Blanc . An ode to quiet luxury, Cedrus Blanc opens with a shimmering brightness — sparkling aldehydes lift into the air like light catching on crystal, while zesty bergamot lends a crisp, sunlit freshness. It's an entrance that feels effortlessly refined, clean yet full of life.. At its heart, orange blossom unfolds in soft, honeyed elegance. Delicate and luminous, this white floral gives the fragrance a graceful warmth — romantic without ever being heavy, poised somewhere between spring petals and golden afternoon light.. As it settles, Cedrus Blanc reveals its serene, sophisticated soul. Creamy white musk wraps the skin in velvety comfort, while smooth vanilla adds a whisper of sweetness. Grounding it all is refined cedarwood — dry, noble, and quietly commanding — leaving a trail that is both intimate and unmistakably elegant.. Clean, contemporary, and timeless, Rayhaan Cedrus Blanc is a fragrance for those who wear confidence lightly — a signature of understated grace.. Top Notes: Aldehydes and Bergamot Heart Notes: Orange Blossom Base Notes: White Musk, Vanilla and Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Khadlaj Shiyaaka Sky Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Shiyaaka Sky opens with a bright, uplifting burst of Bergamot, delivering an immediate sense of crisp citrus freshness and airy clarity that sets a clean, confident tone from the first spray. Herbal Notes weave seamlessly through the composition, adding a green and aromatic depth that grounds the brightness with natural sophistication. Orange Blossoms introduces a soft, luminous floral warmth that lifts the herbal character with delicate femininity and light, while White Musk anchors the entire composition with a smooth, skin-close, and enduring finish that lingers with quiet, understated appeal. . Top Notes: Bergamot, Herbal Notes Heart Notes: Orange Blossoms Base Notes: White Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Velixir Asteria Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: Velixir Asteria Eau de Parfum . Sunlight, captured. Asteria opens like the first light of morning — a vivid burst of blood orange and mandarin, brightened by crisp lemon and refined bergamot. At its heart, creamy tiare flower unfurls, soft and sun-warmed, evoking distant shores and the stillness of golden hour. As it settles, powdery musk wraps around smooth sandalwood, leaving a trail that feels clean, intimate, and quietly luxurious — the kind of warmth that lingers long after you've left the room. . Effortless yet unforgettable. A scent for those who carry brightness with them. . Top Notes: Blood Orange, Mandarin Orange, Lemon, Bergamot Middle Notes: Tiare Flower Base Notes: Powdery Notes, Musk, Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Mykonos On The Rocks Extrait de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Mykonos - On The Rocks Extrait de Parfum 100ml. "I want something sweet, boozy, aromatic, and bold... but make it On The Rocks.". Like a perfectly crafted cocktail, On The Rocks stirs unexpected contrasts into an intoxicating blend. The first spritz is a crisp splash of bergamot and apple, fresh and invigorating, before the rich depth of myrrh swirls in—smooth, warm, and seductively bold, like an amber liquor poured slow.. As the scent settles, the smoky elegance of guaiacwood and the floral sensuality of orange flower unfold, while a hint of praline lingers like the lingering sweetness of an irresistible sip. Finally, vanilla and ambroxan melt into the skin, wrapping you in a trail that’s both sultry and dangerously smooth—the scent of a night you’ll never forget.. Crisp yet deep. Smooth yet daring. Indulgent yet refined. This is your dream drink, bottled. One spritz, and you’re hooked.. Top Notes: Bergamot, Apple, Myrrh Middle Notes: Orange Flower, Guiacwood, Praline Base Notes: Vanilla, Ambroxan, Praline.

listings.rawTitle: Mykonos Monaco Royale Extrait de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Mykonos - Monaco Royale Extrait de Parfum 100ml. Monaco Royale is a fragrance of contrasts—fresh and breezy yet deep and sensual. It opens with fresh and crisp notes of melon, pear, and green accords, evoking the breezy elegance of the French Riviera. The heart reveals warm cedarwood, adding depth and refinement. It dries down to a luxurious blend of caramel, musk, and moss, exuding sophistication of a romantic night in Monaco.. A perfect balance of radiant freshness and sensual allure.. Top Notes: Pear, Melon, Green Notes Middle Notes: Soft Wood, Cedarwood Base Notes: Moss, Caramel, Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Mykonos California Blue EDP 100ml
listings.description: California Blue Extrait de Parfum 100ml. The essence of playful freedom, California Blue captures the feeling of a bright, sunlit day at the beach, where the salty ocean breeze mingles with the playful energy of laughter and adventure.. A burst of juicy pear, grapefruit, and pink salt mirrors the thrill of the first dive into cool waves, while rhubarb and water blossoms carry the carefree spirit of sun-kissed fun. The scent settles into a comforting blend of softwood, moos, and caramel, reminiscent of golden beach sunsets.. This is the fragrance for the free-spirited drifter, someone who finds joy in the ocean's embrace and lives for spontaneous moments of adventure and excitement. Lighthearted, fruity, fresh, and aquatic.. California Blue embodies the soul of summer and the endless call of the waves.. Top Notes: Lavender, Pear, Grapefruit, Pink Salt. Middle Notes : Rhubarb, Water Blossoms, Marine Notes. Base Notes: Moss, Softwood, Caramel.

listings.rawTitle: Mykonos California Signature Extrait de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: California Signature Extrait De Parfum by Mykonos (100ml) is a citrus aromatic fragrance inspired by Lafayette Street. Bright citrus, smooth aromatics, and warm woods blend into a modern luxury scent with clean sophistication.. The fragrance opens with mandarin orange and lemon, creating a sparkling citrus introduction that feels vibrant, refreshing, and uplifting.. At the heart, lychee, rosemary, cardamom, lavender, geranium, and aquatic notes create a refined aromatic blend with subtle sweetness, freshness, and smooth aquatic depth.. As the scent settles, the base of tonka bean, teak wood, and vetiver delivers a warm, woody finish with creamy sophistication and lasting elegance.. Top Notes: Mandarin Orange, Lemon. Middle Notes: Lychee, Rosemary, Cardamom, Lavender, Geranium, Aquatic Notes. Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Teak Wood, Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Mykonos x SetiawanAde Glitch Extrait de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Glitch Extrait De Parfum by Mykonos x SetiawanAde (100ml) is a bold fruity woody fragrance that blends sparkling citrus, smoky fruits, aromatic florals, and creamy vanilla into a modern statement scent.. The fragrance opens with Sicilian bergamot, apple, grapefruit, and charred pineapple, creating a juicy citrus burst layered with smoky tropical sweetness and vibrant freshness.. At the heart, lavender, artemisia, lily of the valley, pink pepper, vanilla, and dried jasmine create a warm aromatic floral blend with soft sweetness and spicy depth.. As the scent settles, the base of patchouli, vanilla, and musk delivers a creamy musky finish with woody warmth and long-lasting sensuality.. Top Notes: Sicilian Bergamot, Apple, Grapefruit, Charred Pineapple. Middle Notes: Lavender, Artemisia, Lily of the Valley, Pink Pepper, Vanilla, Dried Jasmine. Base Notes: Patchouli, Vanilla, Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Le Falcone Juman Precious Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Juman Precious opens with a burst of Blackcurrant and Raspberry for an immediate sensation of crushed berries and forest sweetness. The heart reveals a sophisticated core, while Rum provides a dark, fermented warmth. The drydown reveals a majestic, velvety foundation of Vanilla. Anchored in rich gourmand depth, it leaves a persistent, sugary trail that stays vibrant on the skin for over 10 hours.. Top Notes: Blackcurrant and Raspberry Middle Notes : Rum Base Notes: Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Risala For You Le Falcone Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Risala For You opens with a burst of Neroli and Honeysuckle, offering an immediate sensation of fresh nectar and a citrus breeze. The heart reveals a sophisticated core, with Marshmallow and Iris providing a powdery, pillowy texture against a backdrop of Jasmine. The drydown reveals a majestic, golden foundation of Caramel. Anchored by Vanilla and Labdanum, it leaves a persistent, sweet trail that remains vibrant on the skin for over 12 hours.. Top Notes: Honeysuckle, Orange Blossom, Neroli, Pink Pepper, and Coriander Middle Notes: Iris, Marshmallow, Jasmine, and Rose Base Notes: Caramel, Sugar, Vanilla, Musk, and Labdanum.

listings.rawTitle: Le Falcone Risala Autograph Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Risala Autograph opens with a burst of Lime and Thyme for an immediate sensation of citrus brightness and herbal garden freshness. The heart reveals a sophisticated core where Orange Blossom and Coconut provide a creamy floral texture against a backdrop of Oakmoss. The drydown reveals a majestic, animalic foundation of Leather. Anchored by Ambergris and Juniper Berries, it leaves a persistent and mineral trail that stays vibrant on the skin for over 12 hours. . Fragrance Notes Top Notes: Lemon, Lime, Blackcurrant, Pink Pepper, Thyme, and Apple Middle Notes: Oakmoss, Labdanum, Orange Blossom, Lily, and Coconut Base Notes: Cedar, Ambergris, Moss, Leather, Amber, Mate, Tonka Bean, and Juniper Berries .

listings.rawTitle: Surrati Pur Musk Extrait de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: The fragrance opens with the gentle simplicity of musk, creating a fresh and soft introduction that feels pure and calming. In the heart, white flowers and sweet accords add smooth floral sweetness, giving the scent a warm, comforting character without becoming heavy.. As the fragrance settles, spicy notes and aromatic woods create a rich and balanced base, leaving a long-lasting trail with soft warmth and depth. The Extrait De Parfum concentration delivers strong performance, making Pur Musk ideal for everyday wear, layering, or for those who enjoy clean, musky fragrances.. Pur Musk is perfect for anyone who loves soft oriental perfumes with a smooth, elegant, and long-lasting finish.. Top Notes: Musk Heart Notes: White Flowers, Sweet Accords Base Notes: Spicy Notes, Aromatic Woods.

listings.rawTitle: Surrati Fabrica 1929 Extrait de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Fabrica 1929 opens with a bright, luminous burst of Bergamot, delivering immediate citrus clarity and a clean, polished freshness that sets a timelessly elegant and refined tone. The heart blooms into Jasmine and Orange Blossom, adding a classic, softly heady floral warmth that carries the composition with graceful, enduring sophistication. The base settles into Amber and Musk, leaving a warm, smooth and skin-close trail. . Top Notes: Bergamot Heart Notes: Jasmine and Orange Blossom Base Notes: Amber and Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Surrati Rosso Ombre Extrait de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Rosso Ombre opens with Bergamot and Lemon, delivering clean, bright citrus clarity that feels sharp and composed before the deeper notes emerge. The heart brings Oud Wood and Flowers together, pairing a dark resinous richness with a soft floral lift that gives the composition balance and warmth. The base of Amber and Musk closes smoothly, grounding everything in a quietly glowing warmth that carries well into the dry-down. . Top Notes: Bergamot, Lemon Heart Notes: Oud Wood, Flowers Base Notes: Amber, Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Surrati Atlantis Eau de Parfum 140ml
listings.description: Atlantis by Surrati is a captivating marine fragrance that embodies the calm and power of oceanic air. This scent mirrors the rhythm of waves — invigorating, deep, and timelessly elegant.. It opens with the zesty brightness of lemon and bergamot, refreshed by crystalline ambroxan. The heart brings ambergris and sea salt, adding smooth warmth and aquatic sensuality. Finally, fennel, cedarwood, and musk anchor the scent with soft depth and sophistication.. Fragrance Notes Top Notes: Lemon, Bergamot, Ambroxan Heart Notes: Ambergris, Amber, Sea Salt Base Notes: Fennel, Cedarwood, Musk, Sandalwood .

listings.rawTitle: Surrati Honey Oud Eau de Parfum 140ml
listings.description: Honey Oud Eau de Parfum by Surrati this luxurious unisex's perfume opens with the spicy allure of cardamom, delivering a warm and exotic touch. At its heart lies a captivating blend of roses and jasmine, exuding timeless floral elegance and romance. As the fragrance unfolds, the base reveals the rich, woody depth of oud, beautifully complemented by amber's resinous warmth and vanilla's sweet embrace.. Designed for those who desire sophistication and charm, this long-lasting perfume offers an exquisite balance of florals, spices, and sensual warmth. Discover why Honey Oud stands out among unisex's fragrances and embodies the essence of refined perfumes for unisex.. Top Notes: Cardamom Heart Notes: Roses, Jasmine Base Notes: Oud, Amber, Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Surrati Gray Oud Extrait de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Introducing Surrati Gray Oud Extrait De Parfum. A bold and modern 150ml unisex fragrance that offers an exceptional, luxurious scent experience. This Extrait De Parfum is a refined blend of authentic Oud combined with distinctive notes of Saffron and Leather, reflecting confidence and individuality in every spritz. . Top Notes: Oud, Saffron. Middle Notes: Aromatic Woods, Patchouli. Base Notes: Amber, Leather.

listings.rawTitle: Surrati Dream Valley Eau de Parfum 140ml
listings.description: Introducing Surrati Dream Valley Eau De Parfum. A unique and enchanting 140ml unisex fragrance designed to combine elegance and luxury. Part of the prestigious Surrati Heritage Collection, this Eau De Parfum is a refined blend of invigorating Bergamot, Lemon and Mint, a romantically blooming heart of Rose, Jasmine and Orange Blossom, and a comforting Amber, Musk and Sandalwood foundation, reflecting confidence and individuality in every spritz.. Top Notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Mint Heart Notes: Rose, Jasmine, Orange Blossom Base Notes: Amber, Musk, Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Al Ambra Black Forest Elixir Extrait de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: This elegant fragrance combines the freshness of citrus fruits, delicate floral notes, and woody and musky tones in a complex and memorable composition.. Each layer unfolds with refined precision, zesty top notes of aldehydes, white peach, bergamot, mandarin, and orange give way to a soft floral heart of orange blossom, ambrette, lily-of-the-valley, vetiver, and mahonia. The composition is anchored by a warm, sensual base of musk, ambroxan, Akigalawood, vanilla, vetiver, and patchouli,. Presented in a new 50ml bottle with a bold, modern design, this perfume reflects the luxurious identity of the Al Ambra house. Its distinctive scent is crafted for those who appreciate timeless elegance and contemporary sophistication, making it a signature choice for both day and evening wear.. Top Notes: White Peach, Aldehydes, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot. Heart Notes: Mahonia, Lily of the Valley, Orange Blossom, Ambrette, Vetiver. Base Notes: Ambroxan, Musk, Vanilla, Akigalawood, Patchouli, Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Al Ambra Black Forest Extrait de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Discover the allure of Black Forest, a captivating perfume extrait designed for both men and women. This exquisite fragrance opens with a vibrant burst of Grapefruit, offering a fresh and sparkling introduction that instantly captivates the senses. As it unfolds, the heart reveals the warm, sensual notes of Ambroxan. What truly sets Black Forest apart are its rich woody base notes, which lend an intensity and lasting presence that lingers.. . Top Notes: Grapefruit Heart Notes: Ambroxan Base Notes: Woody Notes. .

listings.rawTitle: Bujarami Daddy Issues Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Bujairami Daddy Issues. Sophisticated, mysterious, and just a little bit dangerous — Bujairami Daddy Issues is the scent of effortless allure. Creamy, woody, and quietly seductive, it's a fragrance that lingers in the memory long after the first encounter.. It opens with a smooth, green sweetness: milky fig paired with dewy water lily and tart cassis, striking a balance that's fresh, fruity, and instantly intriguing. Understated yet magnetic — it draws you in without ever trying too hard.. At its heart, powdery iris and elegant orris root entwine with a touch of sensual jasmine, adding a refined, velvety depth that feels expensive and undeniably grown-up. This is where the fragrance shows its true, sophisticated character.. The dry-down seals the seduction. Soft musk, creamy sandalwood, rich Madagascar vanilla, and earthy patchouli leaf melt into a warm, addictive finish — smooth, sensual, and impossible to resist. It clings to the skin and leaves a trail worth chasing.. Confident, alluring, and irresistibly smooth, Bujairami Daddy Issues is for those who know exactly what they want.. Fragrance Notes Top: Fig, Water Lily, Cassis Heart: Iris, Orris Root, Jasmine Base: Musk, Sandalwood, Madagascar Vanilla, Patchouli Leaf.

listings.rawTitle: Bujairami Pearadise Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Bujairami Pearadise. Sweet, creamy, and utterly dreamy — Bujairami Pearadise is a little slice of heaven in a bottle. This luscious fruity-gourmand fragrance wraps you in softness and light, like a warm escape to somewhere golden and serene.. It opens with pure temptation: juicy pear drenched in sparkling citrus, delivering a bright, mouth-watering burst that's fresh, fun, and instantly uplifting. It's the kind of opening that makes you smile.. At its heart, the fragrance turns soft and radiant. Creamy gardenia and fresh freesia bloom alongside hydrating coconut water, creating a smooth, tropical floral haze that feels as soothing as it is beautiful — feminine, glowing, and irresistibly touchable.. The dry-down is pure indulgence. Smooth sandalwood, warm cashmere, and rich vanilla caviar melt together into a velvety, skin-like finish that lingers with cozy sweetness. It's comforting, elegant, and endlessly huggable.. Radiant, playful, and impossibly addictive, Bujairami Pearadise is your everyday escape to paradise.. Fragrance Notes Top: Juicy Pear, Sparkling Citrus Heart: Creamy Gardenia, Fresh Freesia, Hydrating Coconut Water Base: Smooth Sandalwood, Warm Cashmere, Rich Vanilla Caviar.

listings.rawTitle: Bujairami Confessions Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Confessions opens with a bright and lively burst of Amalfi lemon and bergamot, enhanced by the fruity richness of black currant and the floral touch of African orange flower, while tagetes adds a slightly green and aromatic nuance.. As the fragrance develops, a soft floral heart emerges with violet, cyclamen, and jasmine, creating a delicate and elegant balance.. In the dry down, earthy vetiver blends with warm amber, smooth musk, and cedarwood, forming a clean, woody base that lingers with refined depth. . Confessions — a sophisticated fragrance journey where vibrant citrus, soft florals, and warm woods come together in a modern and expressive scent.. Top Notes: Amalfi Lemon, Tagetes, Black Currant, Bergamot, African Orange Flower. Heart Notes: Violet, Cyclamen, Jasmine. Base Notes: Vetiver, Musk, Amber, Virginia Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Bujairami Full Throttle Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Bujairami Full Throttle. Fast, fresh, and full of energy — Bujairami Full Throttle is the scent for those who live life at full speed. A vibrant fusion of spice, citrus, and smooth warmth, it's built to keep you moving from morning to midnight.. It launches with an electric kick: peppery pink pepper meets sparkling bergamot and juicy mandarin, delivering an instant hit of freshness with a spicy edge. It's bright, punchy, and impossible to ignore.. At its heart, aromatic clary sage blends with tart, fruity blackcurrant, adding depth and a cool, confident smoothness that keeps the fragrance dynamic and effortlessly modern.. The dry-down brings it all home: earthy vetiver and warm, sweet tonka bean create a smooth, addictive finish that's both grounded and inviting. It's the kind of trail that lasts through whatever the day throws at you.. Energetic, versatile, and endlessly wearable, Bujairami Full Throttle is your everyday shot of adrenaline.. Fragrance Notes Top: Pink Pepper, Bergamot, Mandarin Heart: Clary Sage, Blackcurrant Base: Vetiver, Tonka Bean.

listings.rawTitle: Bujairami Dirty Money Extrait de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Bujairami Dirty Money. Smooth, luxurious, and unapologetically bold — Bujairami Dirty Money is the scent of success worn on the skin. Refined yet raw, it's a leathery amber fragrance that exudes power, ambition, and quiet confidence.. It opens with a warm, aromatic spark of cardamom — spicy, smooth, and instantly inviting. A minimalist beginning that hints at the richness to come.. At its heart, sumptuous leather meets the heady elegance of jasmine sambac, blending rugged masculinity with a touch of floral opulence. It's a contrast that feels expensive, magnetic, and effortlessly sophisticated.. The base is where the fragrance truly earns its name. Golden amber, earthy moss, and dark, resinous patchouli settle into a deep, sensual finish — smoky, long-lasting, and impossible to forget. This is a scent that lingers in the room and stays on the mind.. Rich, commanding, and made for those who play to win, Bujairami Dirty Money is your signature of understated luxury.. Fragrance Notes Top : Cardamom Heart: Leather, Jasmine Sambac Base: Amber, Moss, Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Bujairami Mad Love Extrait de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Bujairami Mad Love. Passionate, daring, and impossible to ignore — Bujairami Mad Love is a fragrance built for obsession. Rich, leathery, and deeply sensual, it's the scent of desire turned into something you can wear.. It opens with a seductive rush: juicy raspberry drizzled over precious saffron and aromatic geranium, striking a bold balance of sweet, spicy, and refined. It's an entrance that turns heads from the very first breath.. At its heart, velvety rose blooms against smoky birch wood, supple suede leather, and a wisp of mysterious incense. This is where the fragrance reveals its true character — dark, romantic, and unapologetically intense.. The dry-down is pure indulgence. Precious oud wood melts into warm benzoin balm, smooth amberwood, and soft musk, leaving a trail that's rich, resinous, and utterly addictive. It clings to the skin for hours, drawing others closer with every move.. Fierce, luxurious, and made to be remembered, Bujairami Mad Love is for those who love a little too hard and wear it with pride.. Fragrance Notes Top : Raspberry, Saffron, Geranium Heart: Rose, Birch Wood, Suede Leather, Incense Base: Oud Wood, Benzoin Balm, Amberwood, Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Bujairami Oasis Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Bujairami Oasis. Bold, spicy, and effortlessly refined — Bujairami Oasis is a striking woody-aromatic fragrance for those who command attention without saying a word. Like a burst of green calm in the middle of the desert, it balances fiery spice with cool, composed elegance.. It opens with a jolt of energy: zesty bergamot collides with the electric heat of Nepalese Sichuan pepper and warm, rosy pink pepper. The result is an immediate, spicy-fresh signature that feels alive and self-assured from the very first spray.. At its heart, tart blackcurrant and aromatic geranium intertwine with a touch of velvety rose, adding depth, richness, and a subtle floral sophistication that keeps the composition intriguing.. As it dries down, a smooth, masculine base of amberwood, cedarwood, and earthy vetiver takes hold — dry, woody, and beautifully long-lasting. It's the kind of finish that lingers close to the skin and leaves a lasting impression wherever you go.. Confident, contemporary, and endlessly wearable, Bujairami Oasis is your everyday statement of quiet power.. Fragrance Notes Top: Bergamot, Nepalese Sichuan Pepper, Pink Pepper Heart: Blackcurrant, Geranium, Rose Base: Amberwood, Cedarwood, Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Bujairami Real Deal Extrait de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Bujairami Real Deal . Fresh, clean, and effortlessly confident — Bujairami Real Deal is the scent for those who keep it authentic. This is a crisp, green-aquatic fragrance that feels like a deep breath of open air: bright, invigorating, and undeniably modern.. It opens with a burst of energy. Sparkling bergamot and juicy mandarin orange meet the delicate elegance of neroli, while tart blackcurrant bud and green, aromatic galbanum add a sharp, contemporary edge. The effect is instantly refreshing — vibrant without ever trying too hard.. At its heart, cool green tea and a whisper of blackcurrant are lifted by a salty, ozonic breeze, evoking clean skin and sea air. It's a smooth, breathable pulse that keeps the fragrance feeling light and alive throughout the day.. As it settles, soft musk, creamy sandalwood, and woody petitgrain ground the composition in a warm, understated finish — subtle, skin-close, and quietly magnetic. Not loud, not flashy, just genuinely good.. For the man or woman who lets quality speak for itself, Bujairami Real Deal is exactly what the name promises.. Fragrance Notes Top: Bergamot, Mandarin Orange, Neroli, Blackcurrant Bud, Galbanum Heart: Green Tea, Blackcurrant, Salty / Ozonic Note Base: Musk, Sandalwood, Petitgrain.

listings.rawTitle: Bujairami Deep Night Extrait de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Bujairami Deep Night. When the lights go low and the world quiets down, Bujairami Deep Night comes alive. This is a fragrance of depth and drama — a rich, oud-driven composition that wraps you in warmth and mystery from the very first breath.. It opens with a bold, romantic flourish: velvety Bulgarian rose entwined with powdery violet and a juicy touch of strawberry, striking a balance between sweet seduction and timeless elegance. At its heart, a single, opulent note of Turkish rose blooms — regal, full-bodied, and unmistakably luxurious.. Then the fragrance descends into its true character. Precious agarwood (oud) anchors a smouldering base of amber, benzoin, and cedar, softened by indulgent swirls of vanilla and caramel. The effect is deep, resinous, and impossibly addictive — a scent that clings to the skin and lingers in the air long after you've left the room.. Bold yet refined, sweet yet smoky, Bujairami Deep Night is made for those who want to be remembered. This is your fragrance for the nights that never fade.. Fragrance Notes Top : Bulgarian Rose, Violet, Strawberry Heart: Turkish Rose Base : Agarwood (Oud), Vanilla, Amber, Benzoin, Caramel, Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Bujairami Date Night Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Bujairami Date Night. Some evenings ask for a scent that lingers just as long as the moment. Bujairami Date Night is built for exactly that — an intimate, magnetic fragrance that opens bright and settles into something warm, spiced, and unforgettable.. The first impression is fresh and inviting: crisp apple and zesty bergamot and orange sparkle against a soft breath of lavender, setting a mood that feels effortless and alluring. As it warms to the skin, a delicate floral heart of violet and jasmine unfolds — romantic, refined, and quietly seductive.. Then comes the part you'll remember. A rich base of creamy vanilla and smooth sandalwood is lifted by a flicker of cardamom and pepper, while earthy patchouli grounds the whole composition in lasting depth. The result is a sillage that draws people closer and stays with you long after the night ends.. Sensual, sophisticated, and made to be noticed — Bujairami Date Night is your signature for the evenings that matter.. Fragrance Notes Top: Apple, Lavender, Bergamot, Orange Heart: Violet, Jasmine Base: Vanilla, Cardamom, Sandalwood, Pepper, Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Rasasi Hawas Reina Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Rasasi Hawas Reina is a captivating fragrance inspired by timeless feminine elegance. Bursting with juicy apricot, radiant jasmine, and creamy vanilla, it blends delicate florals with warm amber and soft benzoin to create a sensual, long-lasting scent that's perfect for both everyday wear and special occasions.. Top Notes: Apricot, Cinnamon Heart Notes: Jasmine, Jasmine Sambac, Orange Blossom, Coffee Base Notes: Vanilla, Amber, Benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: Zimaya Modesh Noble Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A modern expression of confidence and effortless sophistication, Modhesh Noble is designed for men who move with quiet power. This fragrance opens with a vibrant, energetic freshness that immediately feels polished and contemporary. As it evolves, the heart reveals a smooth, elegant character - clean, comforting, and irresistibly refined, creating a perfectly balanced signature that feels both intimate and commanding. The dry-down settles into a warm, sensual trail that lingers beautifully on the skin, leaving an impression of depth, strength, and understated luxury. Modhesh Noble is more than a fragrance. It is a statement of modern masculinity, crafted for everyday elegance and elevated moments - bold yet refined, timeless yet unmistakably current.. Top Notes: Bergamot, Cardamom, Black Currant, & Ginger Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Musk, & Lavender Base Notes: Patchouli & Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Badee Al Oud Amethyst Fusion Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Badee Al Oud Amethyst Fusion. Where warmth meets indulgence — an oriental gourmand that lingers like a treasured memory.. Badee Al Oud Amethyst Fusion opens with a spirited flourish of amaretto, mandarin, and rum — a heady, almost intoxicating welcome that pairs the sweetness of almond liqueur with bright citrus and a warming splash of spirit. It opens with a lively burst of litchi, bergamot, and ginger, delivering an invigorating and refreshing introduction. At its heart, a delicate floral combination of peony and rose emerges, enriched by the soft sweetness of vanilla. Middle Notes: Peony, Rose, Vanilla. Base Notes: Chocolate, Patchouli. . . . .

listings.rawTitle: Fragrance World Elysia Sweet Banana EDP 100ml
listings.description: The first spritz smells like ripe banana and juicy pear. A silky, tropical creaminess from the coconut makes the dish more dessert-like. Flowers like jasmine soften the sweetness and give the heart a hint of airy femininity.. Vanilla gives the smell a warm, soothing gourmand finish, and sandalwood offers a delicate, creamy woodiness that lasts without being sugary.. Top Notes: Banana and Pear Middle Notes: Coconut and Jasmine Base Notes: Vanilla and Sandalwood..

listings.rawTitle: Ombre D’or 75ml EDP by Armaf
listings.description: Ombre D’or 75ml EDP by Armaf is a sophisticated fragrance that combines elegance, depth, and mystery in every spray. Top Notes: Lime and Musk Middle Notes: Metallic notes, Saffron, Iris and Rose Base Notes: Incense, Woody Notes and Amber The fragrance opens with the fresh zest of lime wrapped in the soft sensuality of musk, creating a captivating introduction that feels both uplifting and alluring. At the heart, a daring blend of metallic notes intertwines with the warmth of saffron, while iris and rose add a touch of refined floral elegance. As the scent settles, the base reveals its true depth: smoky incense blends with earthy woody notes and the golden richness of amber. This creates a long-lasting, warm, and mysterious trail that exudes confidence and charisma.. Ombre D’or 75ml EDP by Armaf is more than just a perfume—it is an experience of contrasts, where freshness meets warmth, and elegance meets strength. Perfect for evening wear or special occasions, this fragrance leaves an unforgettable impression wherever you go..

listings.rawTitle: Armaf Club De Nuit Untold Eau de Parfum Spray 105ml
listings.description: Experience the ultimate in sophistication with Armaf Club De Nuit Untold Eau de Parfum. Middle Notes: Amberwood and Ambergris. Base Notes: Fir Resin and Cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Rayhaan Ocean Rush 100ml EDP by Rayhaan
listings.description: Rayhaan Ocean Rush is a refreshing and invigorating fragrance inspired by the boundless energy of the ocean. The base anchors the fragrance with the softness of musk, the earthy richness of patchouli, and the mineral warmth of amber, creating a long-lasting and captivating finish reminiscent of sunlit shores..

listings.rawTitle: Laathani Extrait de Parfum 80ml by Ahmed Al Maghribi

listings.rawTitle: French Avenue SH'MALLOW Fluff Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Sh’mallow Fluff by French Avenue is a whimsical treat for the senses—a playful and mouthwatering Eau De Parfum that swirls together sugary softness, creamy fruits, and delightful gourmand charm. Finally, the base of vanilla, musk, ambrox, and praline settles into an addictive warmth that clings like a cozy hug.. Notes: . Top Notes: 🍋 Lemon, 🍎 Apple, 🍓 Strawberry Jam, 🥥 Coconut Middle Notes: 🌸 Orange Blossom, 🤍 Marshmallow, 🌼 Jasmine Base Notes: 🍦 Vanilla, 🌟 Musk, 🌊 Ambrox, 🍫 Praline .

listings.rawTitle: Lattafa Vanilla Freak Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: It has a light, fluffy sweetness that makes you want to eat it right away, like the first bite of a freshly baked treat. It is enjoyable and instantly makes you feel better.. An enduring, cozy return of smooth butter, classic vanilla, and soft musk that clings to you like a cherished memory. Intimate, smooth, and beautifully luxurious.. listings.rawTitle: Lattafa Cookie Crave Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: The opening welcomes you with the rich, comforting smell of melted butter and cocoa. It's like a warm hug that makes you feel good right away with the smell of newly baked goods. . This combination gives it an irresistibly gourmet feel, like you've just eaten a warm, sugar-dusted biscuit. . The dry-down lasts a long time and smells like a lovely mix of whipped cream, sweet vanilla, and calm sandalwood. The end result? This long-lasting, velvety trail strikes a balance between lighthearted sweetness and delicate depth. It's great for anyone who wants to leave a warm, memorable impression.. Top Notes: Butter, Cocoa Middle Notes: Milk, Cookie, Sugar Base Notes: Whipped Cream, Sandalwood, Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Lattafa Choco Overdose Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: At first, it smells like dark, smooth, and very tempting chocolate fudge. If you take a bite, it's like getting a scoop of good chocolate. The sweetness draws you in and makes you want more.. When the smell changes, a soft, fun pair of cupcake sweetness and chocolate powder comes out. The sweet, seductive, and definitely attractive scent from this mix lasts for a long time.. Top Note: Chocolate Fudge Middle Notes: Cupcake and Cocoa Base Notes: Vanilla, Benzoin and Caramel.

listings.rawTitle: Lattafa Berry On Top Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: A light and airy start that instantly elevates the spirits—a beautifully welcoming swirl of chantilly cream and freshly ripened strawberry sets the mood. . Velvety white blossoms mix with a sweet haze of caramelized sugar and strawberry jam to make a heart that is both romantic and indulgent. . The scent wraps you in a warm, comfortable blanket as it settles. It's a relaxing mix of creamy vanilla and soft musk that stays with you, leaving a delicate, seductive trail.. listings.rawTitle: Lattafa Whipped Pleasure Eau de Parfum 75ml

listings.rawTitle: Lattafa Mallow Madness Eau de Parfum 75ml

Finally, the scent settles into a base of soft vanilla, smooth musk, and fluffy whipped cream that is hard to resist. This creamy base leaves a long-lasting, sensual trail that stays with you long after you've put it on.. Top Notes: Strawberry, Raspberry. Middle Notes: Marshmallow, Freesia. Base Notes: Vanilla, Cream, Musk.

listings.rawTitle: French Avenue Amber Empire Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The first smell is an oriental harmony with creamy woods and a hint of sweetness. Top Notes: Oriental Accord, Cashmere Wood, Vanilla Wood, Liquorous Accord Middle Notes: Cedarwood, Amber, Cane Sugar Base Notes: Musk, Tonka Beans, Labdanum, Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Lattafa Dynasty Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Dynasty 100ml EDP by Lattafa is a modern fragrance masterpiece that balances freshness, warmth, and sophistication. Crafted for those who appreciate refined elegance with a bold twist, this Eau de Parfum embodies confidence and timeless style in every spray. listings.rawTitle: Paris Corner Perseviron EDP 100ml
listings.description: The first part of Perseviron smells like a mix of warm spices: cinnamon, cardamom, and bergamot. Last but not least, Perseviron ends on a lovely base of dry woods, guaiac wood, and vanilla. It has lasting depth and a quietly powerful trail.. Top Notes: Cinnamon, Cardamom and Bergamot. Middle Notes: Praline, Whipped Cream and Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Guaiac Wood, Vanilla and Dry Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Ana Abiyedh Scarlet (I am White) 60ml EDP by Lattafa

listings.rawTitle: Khanjar 100ml EDP by Niche Emarati Perfumes (Lattafa)

As Khanjar evolves, it reveals a heart composed of cashmeran, violet, and patchouli. Cashmeran, a synthetic note, imparts a woody and musky quality, contributing to the fragrance’s overall warmth. Violet adds a delicate floral facet, while patchouli provides an earthy and slightly sweet character. This combination results in a heart that is both inviting and sophisticated.. The perfume’s base notes anchor the fragrance with depth and sensuality. Vetiver, a classic woody note, offers an earthy and smoky richness. Incense adds an exotic and resinous quality, while musk brings a velvety softness. Leather, with its bold and distinctive aroma, adds a touch of rugged elegance. These base notes create a lasting and memorable trail that lingers on the skin..

listings.rawTitle: Afnan Historic Olmeda Eau de Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Vanilla Voyage Eau De Parfum 100ml by Maison Asrar
listings.description: Vanilla Voyage Eau De Parfum 100ml by Maison Asrar (Gulf Orchid) is an exquisite olfactory journey that captures the essence of indulgence, warmth, and elegance. Crafted for those who crave a scent that is both captivating and comforting, this gourmand fragrance envelops you in layers of sweetness, sensual florals, and creamy musk, making it a must-have in any perfume lover’s collection.. Top Notes: Caramel and Butter Middle Notes: Tonka, Jasmine and Honey Base Notes: Amber, Vanilla and Musk . The scent opens with a delectable blend of caramel and butter, immediately evoking the rich, velvety aroma of a luxurious dessert. This irresistible start draws you in with a gourmand intensity that’s sweet yet sophisticated, making the first impression truly unforgettable.. At the heart, the fragrance softens and deepens with the warm elegance of tonka bean, beautifully complemented by the delicate, floral embrace of jasmine. A drizzle of golden honey adds a syrupy smoothness, weaving a thread of opulence through the fragrance’s center.. The base notes provide a lasting, sensual finish with the creamy depth of vanilla, layered over the resinous glow of amber and the soft allure of musk. This lingering trail leaves a signature that’s both comforting and irresistibly magnetic.. Vanilla Voyage Eau De Parfum by Maison Asrar (Gulf Orchid) is a scent designed to enchant and delight the senses from the very first spray to the final dry-down. Whether worn day or night, its rich, velvety profile wraps around you like a warm embrace, making every moment feel like a luxurious escape. Let your fragrance speak volumes—experience the magic of Vanilla Voyage today..

listings.rawTitle: Elysia Marshmallow Perfume 100ml EDP by Fragrance World
listings.description: The scent starts with a bright and lively mix of Italian lemon and apple, which is softened by the gentle scents of freesia and nectarine blossom. This top layer gives the appearance of being active and airy at the same time, which instantly lifts and delights the senses.. The main flavors are marshmallow and strawberry, which bring back delicious memories. They are mixed with creamy coconut and a gentle flowery note from orange blossom. This mix gives the piece more depth, femininity, and a warm, comfortable feel.. The dry-down is a real delight for the senses. Whipped cream, vanilla, and sugar surround the skin in a delicate gourmand blanket, and musk, raspberry, and ambroxan offer a sensual but clean finish. It's warm and sweet.. Top Notes: Freesia, Italian Lemon, Nectarine Blossom, Apple. Middle Notes: Marshmallow, Strawberry, Coconut, Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Whipped Cream, Sugar, Vanilla, Musk, Raspberry, Ambroxan. .

listings.rawTitle: French Avenue Firestorm Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Aromas of vanilla, incense, and grapefruit make up the harsh beginning. Immediately catching your attention are a sweet, smooth taste, a fragrant resin, and a zesty, energizing essence. . Strong-smelling Clary Sage and warm, musky Ambrette make up the middle of the scent. It's the depth and herbal sophistication of these two notes that balance out the strong beginning. . You can feel the smell staying on your skin because the foundation is made of smooth, creamy Tonka Bean. The face feels warm and smooth after using it.. Top Notes : Vanilla, Incense and Grapefruit Middle Notes: Ambrette and Clary Sage Base Notes: Tonka Bean.

listings.rawTitle: Chaos by French Avenue Extrait de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The scent starts with a bright, juicy explosion of cherry and red berries that immediately grabs the senses with its sweet-tart vitality. This fruity opening is aggressive but fun, and it sets a flirty tone that gets people's attention right away.. The iris is the most important part. It adds a gentle, powdery depth that connects the fruity opening with the sensual base. The iris adds a touch of elegance and gentle flower notes that make the scent more sophisticated.. Chaos Extrait really shines in the dry-down. Vanilla makes everything warmer and creamier, and it goes well with the earthy texture of moss and the bold, sexy richness of leather. The result is a base that is really interesting and lasts with a soft, velvety finish.. Top Notes: Cherry and Red Fruits. Middle Note: Iris. Base Notes: Vanilla, Moss and Leather.

listings.rawTitle: Mahd Al Dhahab 100ml EDP by Arabiyat Prestige
listings.description: Mahd Al Dhahab 100ml EDP by Arabiyat Prestige is an opulent fragrance that captures the essence of golden luxury and timeless elegance. Crafted for those who appreciate deep, oriental aromas with a modern edge, this Eau de Parfum is a bold yet sophisticated scent journey that leaves a powerful impression from the very first spray.. Top Notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Spices Middle Notes : Amber, Oud, Patchouli Base Notes: White Musk, Vanilla, Sandalwood . The fragrance opens with a vibrant burst of bergamot and lemon, immediately awakening the senses with a citrusy freshness. Delicate yet intense spices quickly follow, adding warmth and complexity that lingers softly in the air and prepares the stage for the heart of the perfume.. As the perfume evolves, it unveils a rich and golden heart of amber blended seamlessly with exotic oud and earthy patchouli. This luxurious middle layer evokes the richness of Arabian perfumery, wrapping you in a veil of mystery and sensual depth that feels both ancient and modern.. The base is where Mahd Al Dhahab truly shines, as creamy vanilla and soft white musk merge with smooth sandalwood to create a comforting and addictive dry-down. These base notes offer a lasting trail that is sweet, woody, and musky — a perfect blend that clings beautifully to the skin for hours.. Mahd Al Dhahab 100ml EDP by Arabiyat Prestige is more than just a fragrance; it’s a golden journey through warm, exotic landscapes. Perfect for both day and evening wear, it’s a signature scent that radiates confidence, prestige, and an unforgettable aura..

listings.rawTitle: Khadlaj Island Dreams Extrait de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Bergamot's bright zing and ginger's spicy warmth make you feel alive, like the first wind you feel when you walk onto a sunny beach.. At its core, the scent is juicy and bright from the sun thanks to the sparkling grapefruit flavor. It smells like citrus fruits, which wakes you up and makes you feel both fresh and rich. This makes it great for daytime wear.. As the scent dries down, the refined ambroxan and soft, sensual musk come together to make a hug that is both comforting and seductive. listings.rawTitle: Maison Asrar DXB Eau de Parfum 100ml

Top Notes: Mandarin, Orange, Bergamot Heart Notes: Grapefruit, Ginger Base Notes: Lily of the Valley, Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Asrar Majesty Eau de Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Veneno Scarlet by French Avenue Eau de Parfum 100ml
